summary: Oruka Therapeutics filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an underwritten public offering of up to $500 million in common stock and pre-funded warrants. The company, listed on Nasdaq under ORKA, plans to use proceeds for general corporate purposes. Underwriters include Leerink Partners and TD Cowen, with a 30-day option for an additional $75 million. This is a routine shelf takedown and capital raise, not a special situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The filing does not trigger any special-situations classification.
